statement: The production bootstrap composition assembles the landed call-cell invocation path end-to-end with no dead code and no feature flag: the SQL-runtime handoff boundary (attachSqlRuntimeToStartupOwner, shared by seed and join) constructs the CallBindingRouteResolver, createCallCellRoutingSurface (real ServiceDispatcher + CallCellStatementAdapter over the node MessageRouter), createCallCellBatchExecutor over the real engine parser/partition resolver/query executor, and createCallCellReduceCoordinator over the call_cell_reduce_slots and call_cell_reduce_results system tables (schemas registered for bootstrap partition DDL, CDC-policied control-no-propagation) through the engine internal SQL path, and assigns the composed CallCellInvoker to the ServiceLifecycleCommandOwner so an authenticated CALL BINDING on a production-composed node executes instead of failing closed DEPENDENCY_REQUIRED; the RuntimeServiceHandler receives a CallBindingRouteResolver through runtime-service-handler-setup (self-defaulted over its system table cache when not injected) so INVOKE_CALL_CELL never dereferences null; each shard run and the reduce dispatch carry slot-scoped wire invocation identities so the runtime durable fence never replays one shard into another, and the route resolver spreads consecutive shard slots deterministically across ready replicas; and multi-node reduce evidence over two production-composed nodes proves shard runs executing on replicas of BOTH nodes, each publishing its emitted partials under its own acquired slot lease, reduce invoked exactly once on the replica holding the dedicated reduce lease slot, and exactly one atomically published final snapshot visible to the caller, with the minimal-deployment-call-cell-production-wiring scenario green.
